jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer
jobs.description: **About Parisi Labs** Parisi Labs is building foundational world models for physical industry. We are developing models that learn how complex physical systems behave and reuse that understanding across forecasts, scenarios, and operational decisions. Energy is our first proving ground. We combine historical and live data with operational context, bringing together machine learning research, data infrastructure, and software engineering to turn advances in modeling into useful technology for energy operators. We are a small technical team working directly with the founders on our core models, systems, and products. **About the role** Your initial focus will be Ask The Grid, our live product for exploring the power grid, its markets, and its assets. You will take technical ownership of the application and make it faster, clearer, more reliable, and more useful. You will work across React and TypeScript, maps and time\-series interfaces, APIs, accounts, data\-intensive workflows, and AI\-assisted product experiences. Your scope includes the public product, enterprise\-facing capabilities, and the application work needed for customer deployments. You will work directly with users and customers to understand their workflows, partnering with the founders, applied\-AI engineer, and data engineer on technical scoping and delivery. Your primary ownership is the shared product and the application layer of customer deployments. You will collaborate with, rather than replace, the engineers and researchers responsible for the underlying data and models. **What you'll own** * The public product: maps, radar, assets, network views, and how they work together as one dependable application. * The path from visitor to operator: accounts and organizations, saving and claiming assets, portfolios, private\-data connections, permissions, alerts, and reports. * Product architecture, APIs, performance, observability, reliability, accessibility, and the systems that keep the application dependable. * The agent's interaction quality: how context is selected, how sources are shown, and how the product handles uncertainty, unsupported requests, and unreliable answers. * Customer\-facing workflows and application\-level integrations, working with the engineers who own the underlying data and model systems. * Direct user feedback and production debugging, turning repeated friction into clearer workflows and better software. * Decisions, with the founders and technical team, about what becomes reusable product, what remains customer\-specific, and what should not be built. **What we're looking for** * Experience owning complex, data\-rich applications from an ambiguous user need through implementation, deployment, and production operation. * Strong React and TypeScript skills, together with the backend and API experience needed to own an end\-to\-end product outcome. * Product judgment: the ability to translate complex user needs into understandable interfaces and dependable workflows. * Experience with production debugging, performance, reliability, accounts, and permissions. * The ability to work directly with customers, ask precise questions, and separate the underlying need from a requested implementation. * Clear collaboration across product, data, model, and agent boundaries without treating those boundaries as someone else's problem. Experience with maps, time\-series interfaces, or other complex, data\-rich products is particularly relevant. **First 90 days** * 30 days: Ship to production, understand the product architecture, and identify where real user sessions encounter friction or stall. * 60 days: Ship an end\-to\-end improvement that measurably improves exploration, account creation, or completion of an operator workflow. * 90 days: Own the product application and deliver a practical technical plan for the next reusable capability, informed by product usage and customer needs. **Why join** You will own a live product rather than a narrow feature area. Your work will determine how users encounter and apply our technology, from public exploration to deeper operational use, with direct influence on product architecture, interaction quality, and what we build next. **Location and compensation** Location: New York City or Boston/Cambridge. This is a hybrid role — we expect in\-person collaboration 2–3 days per week. Salary range: $180,000–$260,000 USD.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
jobs.description: **About Dental Intelligence** We are the leading player in the SaaS analytics and workflow space for dental practices, launched in 2015 to help dentists manage and grow their practices. Our best\-in\-class tech makes it more fulfilling to be a dental professional and easier to be a patient. Nearly 9,000 dental practices utilize our platform to practice smarter, generating an average top\-line production increase of 50% in the first 12 months. Whether a practice wants a comprehensive 2\-year growth plan or simply a more effective Morning Huddle, we take the busy work out of growth. Our platform helps practices find patients, schedule them, follow up, collect payments, file their forms, design their treatment plans, and so much more. We seek an experienced Sr Site Reliability Engineer who can help our organization to mature and scale the infrastructure behind our multi\-cloud SaaS platform. If the profile below sounds like you \- let’s talk! **About The Role:** We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to help us mature and scale the infrastructure behind our multi\-cloud SaaS platform. Most of our footprint runs on Microsoft Azure, built from the ground up around cloud architecture principles: autoscaling App Service and Container Apps workloads, VM Scale Sets, and Kafka\-based event streaming form the backbone. We also have a smaller, well\-run presence on AWS, and a Windows\-based on\-premises component that sits at the core of our product and integrates with our cloud environment. This role is primarily focused on Azure, where the biggest opportunity for impact lives, and you'll work across the full multi\-cloud picture. We'd like to see the on\-prem and cloud sides operate as a more unified, well\-integrated system than they do today, and that integration work is part of what makes this role interesting. This is a high\-impact role for someone who thinks in terms of systems rather than tickets, and who treats infrastructure like software. You'll have significant ownership over how our cloud infrastructure is architected, provisioned, secured, and operated going forward. If you get energized by taking a fast\-growing environment and giving it real architectural rigor (consistent patterns, full infrastructure\-as\-code coverage, sane permission models, and cost discipline), this role was built for you. We're looking for someone who wants to build the operating model, establish the standards, and lead the transformation. You should bring genuine software engineering discipline to how that infrastructure work gets done: everything in git, everything reviewed, everything automated. No snowflakes, no manual changes made "just this once." **Location:** This is a fully remote role available to candidates located in U.S. states where Dental Intelligence currently has employees. **What You'll do:*** Own the reliability, scalability, and security posture of our Azure environment end\-to\-end * Lead the effort to bring our infrastructure fully under Terraform\-managed IaC, replacing manual and ad\-hoc provisioning with repeatable, version\-controlled deployments * Treat infrastructure code like production software: everything lives in git, changes go through pull requests and peer review, and modules are tested before they ship * Define and implement a coherent Azure architecture strategy, including resource organization, naming and tagging standards, subscription and management group hierarchy, and network topology * Redesign and enforce least\-privilege access and permission boundaries across Azure RBAC, Entra ID, and service principals * Identify and eliminate wasteful or redundant resource provisioning, and build cost visibility and accountability into how infrastructure is deployed * Build CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure changes so that plan/apply, validation, and policy checks are automated rather than run by hand * Build monitoring, alerting, and observability practices (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, App Insights, or equivalent) that give the team real signal * Manage and modernize the Windows\-based on\-prem component that sits at the core of our product, and work to integrate it more tightly with our Azure environment * Bring the same IaC and automation discipline to bear on our AWS footprint as needed, keeping it as clean and well\-run as it is today * Drive incident response, postmortems, and reliability engineering practices such as SLOs, error budgets, and capacity planning * Partner closely with engineering teams to bake reliability, security, and IaC discipline into the software delivery lifecycle * Mentor other engineers on cloud, IaC, and software engineering best practices, raising the bar across the team **What You Bring:*** 6\+ years in SRE, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering roles, with deep, hands\-on Azure experience * Strong, demonstrable Terraform expertise is required. You should be comfortable designing module structures, managing state, and using Terraform to manage complex, multi\-resource environments from scratch * A genuine cloud mentality: you default to automation, reproducibility, and IaC over manual changes, and you get uncomfortable when infrastructure can't be traced back to code * A real software engineering mindset applied to infrastructure: fluency with git workflows (branching, PRs, code review), a bias toward automating anything done more than once, and discomfort with manual, undocumented changes * Experience with Windows Server administration, IIS, Active Directory/Entra ID, and Windows\-based application stacks, which are critical for the on\-prem component at the core of our product * Solid understanding of Azure networking (VNets, peering, private endpoints, NSGs), identity (Entra ID, RBAC, service principals and managed identities), and cost management tooling * Working knowledge of AWS core services (IAM, VPC, EC2/ECS, etc.) sufficient to support and extend an already well\-architected environment * Experience integrating on\-premises infrastructure with cloud environments (VPN/ExpressRoute, hybrid identity, hybrid networking) * A track record of introducing structure and standards into environments that grew organically or quickly; you enjoy imposing order, not just maintaining it * Strong scripting ability (PowerShell and/or Bash/Python) * Excellent judgment around security and access control; you think in terms of least privilege by default * Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, including making architectural calls and driving them through to adoption **Nice to Have:*** Familiarity with CI/CD tooling (Azure DevOps) for infrastructure pipelines * Prior experience leading a cloud environment from an ungoverned state to a well\-architected one * Relevant certifications (Azure Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator, HashiCorp Terraform Associate) **What You'll Love About Dental Intelligence:*** Flexible Paid Time Off \+ 10 company\-wide paid holidays * Competitive Medical, Dental \& vision offerings, with buy up plan options, AND we match your HSA contributions. * Fully Paid Parental Leave * 401K Retirement savings plan with company match up to 5\.5% of your earnings\+ unlimited access to personal financial advisors. * Learning \& Development Reimbursement program * Company paid Life, Disability \& AD\&D * Mental Health support programs, Cellphone \& Gym membership Discounts, Corporate Sundance Passes, and more! **Please Note:** All offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of a background check, which may include verification of education, employment history, and other credentials. By applying, you confirm that all information you have provided is accurate and complete to the best of your knowledge, and you understand that misrepresentation may result in disqualification or termination.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Internal Platforms
jobs.description: Software Engineer, Internal Platforms is a remote engineering review track for evaluating production code, debugging traces, and developer\-facing AI outputs against real\-world correctness standards. jobs.title: Sr. Five9 CCaaS Implementation Engineer
jobs.description: About Lion Mountain Lion Mountain is a professional services firm focused entirely on Five9 contact center implementations and migrations. We help mid\-market and enterprise customers move from legacy on\-premise systems and competing CCaaS platforms onto Five9, design the solution that actually fits their business, and stay with them through go\-live and beyond. We were Five9’s High Performance Demand Partner of 2025, and are on track to repeat for 2026\. We are a small, senior team that wins on depth, not volume. Our customers hire us because of our in\-depth Five9 knowledge, we treat their CRM and telephony stack like our own, and we do not hand work off to junior resources. Every engineer here owns customer outcomes end to end. The Role We are hiring an Implementation Engineer who can act as the lead Five9 solution architect on customer engagements. You will own implementations from discovery through go\-live: scoping the work, designing the call flows and integrations, configuring the Five9 environment, integrating it with the customer’s CRM, training their team, and standing behind it after launch. This is a customer\-facing, hands\-on role. You will be the technical expert in the room — the person the customer’s operations lead, IT lead, and CX leader all turn to. You will be backed by a small team of senior peers, with room to shape how we deliver as we grow. What You’ll DoLead Five9 implementations end to end * Run discovery workshops with customer business and technical stakeholders to capture current\-state contact center flows, pain points, and target outcomes. * Translate business requirements into a Five9 solution design — IVR / IVA flows, ACD and skills\-based routing, queues, dispositions, campaigns, reporting, WFM/WFO, and quality management. * Configure and deploy Five9: agent profiles, skills, campaigns, IVR scripts, prompts, DNIS / ANI mapping, dial plans, dispositions, supervisor and reporting setup. * Lead migration from legacy platforms (Genesys, NICE CXone, Avaya, Cisco, Twilio Flex, Amazon Connect, etc.) into Five9 with minimal disruption. * Own UAT, cutover planning, training, and go\-live and post go\-live support. Architect and build CRM integrations * Design and implement CRM integrations between Five9 and customer systems, including Salesforce, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, ServiceTitan, ImproveIt360, ServiceNow, etc.. and proprietary platforms. * Configure screen pop, click\-to\-dial, automated activity logging, and workflow triggers between Five9 and the CRM. * Where adapters are not enough, build custom integrations using the Five9 Agent API, REST/SOAP web services, VCC Agent Desktop Toolkit, and webhooks. * Partner with customer admins and developers to make the integration sustainable after we leave. Serve as the solution architect on each engagement * Own the technical design document and architecture diagrams for each project. * Make trade\-off decisions on routing strategy, IVR design, reporting model, security model, and integration approach — and clearly explain those trade\-offs to the customer. * Anticipate failure modes: telephony carrier handoffs, peak\-volume scaling, disaster recovery, security and compliance constraints (PCI, HIPAA, SOC 2\). * Quality\-check the build before it ever goes in front of the customer. Be the trusted technical voice with the customer * Lead status calls, design reviews, and executive readouts. * Translate fluently between contact center operations, IT, and executive leadership audiences. * Push back constructively when a customer ask will create long\-term pain — and bring an alternative. Make Lion Mountain better * Contribute to our implementation playbooks, reusable templates, and integration patterns. * Mentor peers on tricky Five9 features and integration approaches. * Share what you learn in the field so the whole team gets sharper with every engagement. What We’re Looking ForRequired * Hands\-on Five9 implementation experience. You have personally configured and deployed Five9 for production customers — not just observed or supported it. * Deep familiarity with core Five9 capabilities: IVR / IVA, ACD, campaigns (inbound, outbound, blended), skills\-based routing, Supervisor, reporting, WFA and APIs. * Working knowledge of Five9 Studio 7 / IVR scripting and the Five9 Agent Desktop Plus / VCC Agent. * Experience integrating Five9 with at least 2 major CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, ServiceTitan, ServiceNow, or similar) in production. * Strong understanding of contact center fundamentals: queueing, occupancy, AHT, SLAs, abandonment, blended outbound, compliance dialing (TCPA), call recording requirements. * Solid grasp of telephony concepts: SIP, DIDs, toll\-free, number porting, carrier handoffs, codecs, network requirements for VoIP quality. * Comfort with web technologies used in integrations: REST APIs, JSON, OAuth, webhooks, basic JavaScript. Reading and writing API calls is part of the job. * Excellent customer\-facing communication. You can run a workshop, write a design doc, and present to a VP — in the same week. * Self\-direction. You can own a project end to end without daily oversight. * US\-based and authorized to work in the US without sponsorship. Strongly preferred * Five9 Professional Services or Five9 Partner experience. * Five9 certifications (Implementation, Administrator, IVA, or specialty tracks). * Salesforce Service Cloud admin experience or Salesforce certification. * Experience migrating customers from Genesys, NICE CXone, Avaya, Cisco UCCE/UCCX, or Amazon Connect onto Five9\. * Experience with Five9 Intelligent Virtual Agent (IVA), Agent Assist, and AI / NLU concepts. * Experience in regulated industries: financial services, healthcare, insurance, or BPO. * Light scripting in Python or Node.js for integration glue. Pay: From $45\.00 per hour Expected hours: 30\.0 – 40\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

jobs.description: **Title:** Electrical Engineer II **Client:** Alabama Power **Location:** Birmingham, AL **Contract:** 3 Years **Work Arrangement:** Hybrid – In office at least 3 days per week / 12 days per month Job Summary We are seeking an **Electrical Engineer II** to support the **Schatz Grid Visualization and Analytics Center (SGVAC)** within Southern Company’s Research \& Development organization. This role will focus on the development, maintenance, and application of **power system digital twins** , grid modeling and simulation, advanced analytics, and emerging electric grid technologies. The engineer will support research projects involving transmission and distribution systems, real\-time simulation, hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, and grid modernization technologies. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with **PSS®E, PSCAD™, RTDS® and/or OPAL\-RT®, power system modeling, EMT studies, and digital twin development** . Key Responsibilities * Develop, maintain, and apply **power system digital twins** for grid planning, operations, training, technology evaluation, and decision support. * Build, validate, and enhance transmission and distribution system models. * Conduct: + Steady\-state studies + Dynamic simulations + Electromagnetic transient (EMT) studies + Real\-time simulations * Utilize **PSS®E, PSCAD™, RTDS®, and/or OPAL\-RT®** for modeling and simulation. * Develop and support **hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL)** testing environments. * Integrate operational, planning, asset, and measurement data into digital twin and analytical applications. * Evaluate emerging grid technologies and develop technical recommendations. * Support research projects, pilot deployments, and technology demonstrations. * Collaborate with utilities, universities, national laboratories, research organizations, and technology vendors. * Prepare technical reports, presentations, publications, and project documentation. * Present technical findings and recommendations to internal and external stakeholders. Required Qualifications * **Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited college or university required.** * Strong knowledge of **electric power system analysis, modeling, simulation, and operation** . * Demonstrated experience developing and applying power system digital twins. * Proficiency with **PSS®E and PSCAD™** . * Experience with **RTDS® and/or OPAL\-RT®** for real\-time simulation and hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing. * Experience conducting steady\-state, dynamic, EMT, and real\-time simulation studies. * Experience integrating operational, planning, asset, and measurement data into modeling and analytical environments. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Preferred Qualifications * Master’s concentration in **Power Systems, Electric Energy Systems, Controls, Computer Engineering, or related discipline** . * Experience with **PMUs, synchrophasors, SCADA, EMS, DERMS, or digital substations** . * Programming experience with **Python, MATLAB, C\#, Java, or similar languages** . * Familiarity with databases, data analytics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning. * Experience working with electric utilities, research organizations, universities, national laboratories, or technology vendors. * **Professional Engineer (PE) license or ability to obtain licensure** preferred. Key Skills **Power Systems \| Digital Twin \| PSS/E \| PSCAD \| RTDS \| OPAL\-RT \| EMT \| Power System Modeling \| Grid Simulation \| Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop \| Transmission \| Distribution \| SCADA \| EMS \| DERMS \| PMU \| Synchrophasors \| Python \| MATLAB \| Grid Modernization \| R\&D**

Join The AES Corporation, the largest US\-based global power company with a team of 8,300 employees across 12 countries. AES has been **ranked \#1 by BloombergNEF** in renewable energy sales to corporations in the US and Americas for five consecutive years, providing electricity for **millions of people worldwide.** We are proud to foster a strong workplace culture, earning prominent positions in Great Place to Work™ rankings across the markets where we operate. Our spirit of innovation continues to earn industry recognition. AES is the only seven\-time winner of the Edison Electric Institute’s Edison Awards in the twenty\-first century, a distinction honoring global leadership in advancing the electric power industry. If you're ready to be part of a company that's not just adapting to change, but driving it, AES is the place for you. We're not just building a more sustainable future, we're powering it. Apply now and energize your career with a true leader in global energy. **About the Role** As an Engineering Co\-op, you will work alongside experienced engineers and business professionals on projects that support the planning, operation, and modernization of the electric grid. You'll gain valuable hands\-on experience, develop technical and analytical skills, and contribute to initiatives that help drive the responsible energy transition while building your professional network and industry knowledge. Responsabilities: * Support engineers on a variety of electric infrastructure projects designing future state distribution and transmission power system * Develop unique solutions to gather, store, and utilize electrical asset data implemented and collected in the field to improve data driven decision making. jobs.title: Staff Back End Engineer
jobs.description: **About Altruist** Altruist is transforming the multi\-trillion dollar wealth management industry by building an AI platform for wealth professionals. We're looking for exceptional talent to help us achieve our mission of making financial advice better, more affordable, and accessible to all. If you're passionate about challenging the status quo and want to do the most important work of your life, we'd love to meet you! **But first, our values** **Kindness** \- Kindness doesn't *just* equal niceness. We listen to understand. We embrace, and encourage healthy debate and diverse perspectives. We approach conflict openly, honestly, and respectfully. **Brilliance** \- Humility is the skill we're most proud of and possessing a growth mindset is always top of mind. We take ownership in everything we touch; regularly using our unique superpowers to reach a common goal as a team. We succeed and fail as one. **Grit** \- When challenges arise, we stay laser focused on achieving our mission and finding a way forward, even when it's hard. We are nimble and maintain a sense of urgency, swiftly adapting to change and overcoming obstacles. ### **The opportunity** Altruist is in the midst of an exceptional growth phase and we're excited to hire Staff Back End Engineers to join our growing Engineering organization. We have multiple teams hiring for high impact \& high visibility projects, with a particular focus on the security, scalability, and reliability of the platform our clients trust with their assets. Our recruitment team will work with you to match you to the right opportunity to help you grow your career at Altruist. **This is a hybrid role, with an expectation of being in the office three days each week out of our San Francisco FiDi office.** ### **Your impact** * Act as a leader and steward of engineering best practices, helping to mentor other engineers and develop impactful solutions * Own systemic, cross\-service problems end to end — from problem definition through design, implementation, and rollout * Design, build, and harden identity and access management capabilities: authentication, authorization, RBAC, and OAuth/OIDC flows * Strengthen our AWS and cloud infrastructure, including its security posture, configuration, and operational guardrails * Improve database performance, security, and optimization across high\-volume, transactional systems * Harden APIs, services, and distributed systems against failure and abuse * Drive production reliability: lead incident remediation, close out root causes, and build the observability needed to catch issues early * Partner with our Security/CISO team to translate identified gaps into durable engineering solutions you design and ship * Focus on building and scaling services and user\-facing web applications that are customer\-centric, performant, and secure ### **What you bring** * **Experience** — 6\+ years of software engineering experience building precise and scalable distributed systems with best engineering practices * **Full\-stack with a backend lean (a plus)** — You're primarily a backend engineer but comfortable working across the stack; a core engineering background is preferred over a purely product\-focused one * **A track record of building, not just reviewing** — You've shipped meaningful work in security, scale, or infrastructure. This is a builder role, not a Security/AppSec role: we're looking for engineers who own remediation and deliver hardened systems * **Education** — Ideally looking for a B.A. / B.S. degree in relevant fields such as Computer Science or similar Engineering/Mathematics degrees * **Technical aptitude** — You're technologically savvy and can easily get up to speed on modern tech stacks (Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, AWS, Postgres, Kubernetes). Strong Java \+ AWS is a great anchor * **Domain exposure (a plus)** — Fintech, payments, or other security\-sensitive, highly regulated environments * **Ownership** — The pride you put into every aspect of your work is unparalleled and undeniable * **Superb communication** — Intentional dialogue is a superpower. You listen as well as you share your perspective with others * **Resilience** — We're inspired by your unwavering determination to achieve success, no matter the adversity you face along the way * **Assurance** — Your confidence is brilliant, yet ego\-less. You possess a strong knowledge base, the ability to discover the unknown, and are open to differing perspectives * **Creative problem solving** — Identifying the problem is simply not enough. You're instinctually creative with your approach in finding solutions to roadblocks **What we bring** Attracting and retaining top\-tier talent is a priority. We are proud of the culture we've built and are cognizant of the ever\-changing professional landscape. Our dynamic offering of perks and benefits are tailored for you to feel your best while doing your best. * Stunning, amenity\-filled office spaces in Culver City, CA, San Francisco, CA, and Dallas, TX. Our offices are intentionally designed for comfort, collaboration, and productivity. * Competitive total compensation. * Premium healthcare, dental, and vision insurance plans (HMO and PPO). * 401k savings plan with a 4% match and immediate vesting. * 16 week paid parental leave after one year of employment. * Professional growth and development opportunities including an employee mobility program and an annual L\&D budget allocation for each employee. * Company perks program (includes discounts on pet insurance, fitness, cell phone plans, and travel, etc.). * Financial guidance program (includes counseling on navigating debt, tracking personal spend, saving and planning goals, home\-purchasing preparedness, etc.). * One month work from anywhere policy (with the exception of a few countries). *Total compensation includes a competitive benefits package, along with a bonus program for eligible roles. For salaried positions, a salary offer will be determined by a number of factors including experience, skill level, internal pay equity, geographic location, and other relevant business considerations. We review all employee pay and compensation programs regularly to ensure* *fair, equitable, and competitive pay. At Altruist, we are committed to providing fair, equitable, and competitive compensation by leveraging market data to inform our pay bands. Base salaries will be reviewed at regular intervals throughout the year, typically in conjunction with performance review cycles. By evaluating compensation on a regular basis, we are able to reward high performance and ensure all employees have opportunities for growth.* *Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Altruist we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role, but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.*

jobs.title: Product Manager - Mobile Platform
jobs.description: **Make a measurable and mission\-critical impact.** **Join us** **on the** **Product Management** **team** **as a** **Product Manager –****Mobile Platform**, and help shape the future of safer, more efficient, and more reliable operations across the globe. **Start your journey with Anova today****!** **Role Summary** This role's center of gravity is the customer — their experience of the Anova solution and their ability to realize meaningful value from it. You'll grow into deeper ownership as you build your track record here. The Product Manager owns discovery and delivery across a defined product area within the Anova Unify platform. Working closely with a Senior PM or Director, you drive the full product lifecycle for your area — from structured customer research through to shipping, measuring adoption, and iterating. This is a hands\-on execution role: you will write specs, manage a backlog, partner daily with engineering, and get close to customers. You won't be handed a roadmap to execute — you'll help shape it. **Job Duties and Responsibilities:** * Lead deep customer discovery. Design and run ongoing discovery programs — interviews, site visits, usage analysis, win/loss reviews. Develop a differentiated point of view on what customers need, what they'll pay for, and what will create durable competitive advantage. Use AI tools to accelerate research and synthesis. Build conviction before building product. * Own your backlog end\-to\-end. Write specs and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from. Prioritize ruthlessly. Keep the backlog current and free of ambiguity. * Ship and measure. Define success metrics before each release. Monitor adoption post\-launch. Share what you're learning with the broader team and make fast, evidence\-based adjustments. * Partner with engineering and design daily. Be a reliable, responsive partner. Unblock your team. Make trade\-off calls with good judgment and know when to escalate. * Reason across the full stack. Understand how Anova's physical devices, connectivity layer, and cloud platform interact — and make product decisions that account for hardware constraints, firmware cycles, and sensor data quality, not just software capabilities. * Enable go\-to\-market. Write clear release notes, internal briefings, and customer\-facing materials. Help sales and customer success understand what you've shipped and why it matters. * Support customers. Triage escalated product issues in your area. Maintain a feedback loop with support and customer success to surface patterns early. **Outcomes you'll own** * Anova leads customer insight amongst the IoT market. Your deep curiosity about customers, their processes, and how IoT transforms their business will keep Anova the leading player that best understands how IoT leads to value for our customers' customers. * Feature adoption and customer value realization. Features you ship get used, and customers can point to the value. You define the adoption metric before you ship, track it after, and iterate until it moves. * Discovery pipeline. A healthy, evidence\-backed backlog — prioritized from real customer insight, validated with data, and ready for engineering. * On\-time, high\-quality delivery. Your area ships on cadence and predictably. Specs are clear, edge cases are handled, and engineering isn't blocked waiting for answers. * Squad metrics. You track velocity, cycle time, and escaped defects — not to report up, but to spot friction early and remove it. * NPS contribution. Customers in your product area trust the product and feel heard. You stay close to feedback, close the loop on issues, and bring the voice of the customer into every decision. **How you'll work at Anova** * Specs, one\-pagers, and decision memos are how we align a global, distributed team — writing clearly forces clear thinking. AI can help you draft, but writing well remains your skill to own. * You use AI as leverage. You're fluent with LLMs for research, synthesis, drafting, and analysis, and you bring a clear point of view on where AI should — and shouldn't — show up in B2B industrial products. * You reason from data. You define the metric before you ship the feature, and you're comfortable pulling the numbers yourself in a modern BI tool. **What you’ll need to succeed:** **Minimum Requirements \-** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience with mobile platform development, device connectivity, and software deployment. * 3\+ years of experience as a Product Manager, with direct ownership of product area strategy and adoption outcomes. * 6\+ years of total professional experience, spanning product management, software engineering, or related technical functions. * You have at least one example of taking a product, feature, or initiative from zero — no spec, no playbook — to something real and used. * Track record of shipping SaaS or enterprise software in close partnership with engineering teams — from spec to production — using Agile/DevOps. * Experience conducting customer discovery interviews and translating qualitative and quantitative insight into prioritized, well\-scoped backlog items. * Demonstrated use of AI and LLM tools in a PM context — for research, synthesis, spec drafting, competitive analysis, data work, or customer insight. * Ability to write clear, structured specs, one\-pagers, and narratives for cross\-functional audiences. * Comfort reasoning about technical trade\-offs — APIs, data models, integration patterns — credibly with engineers. * Data fluency: define metrics, pull and analyze data in BI tools, and make evidence\-based roadmap calls. **Preferred Qualifications \-** * Prior experience in IIoT, connected\-hardware, SaaS, or industrial technology environments. * Experience shipping ML\- or AI\-assisted features in a SaaS product. * Exposure to industrial or field\-operations workflows — understanding how things work in the physical world. * Background in venture or private\-equity\-backed high\-growth industrial technology companies. **ABOUT ANOVA** We are very proudly “one” Anova — built by integrating the best in IIoT technology and expertise. Anova monitors more than 1,250,000 assets across nearly 80 countries for over 2000 clients, from family businesses to the largest LPG, Industrial Gases, and chemicals companies in the world. Our scale is global. Our service is local. We partner directly with customers, taking a holistic approach and delivering tailored solutions that drive innovation and improvement and make our world safer, more efficient, and reliable. We believe that rewarding work should reward you. As part of Anova, your work, integrity, and commitment are rewarded through competitive compensation and reward strategies, through sincere appreciation, and through opportunities for growth and advancement. We put people first by providing benefits that support your life and well\-being, from health and finance to recognition and reward, and so much more — we've got you covered. If this sounds like a fit for you, apply to join Anova in connecting the industrial world — for better. For more information about how Anova is transforming the Industrial IOT industry, visit us at Anova.com.

jobs.title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Abby Care: Powering the future of care at home for all of America.** ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- Abby Care is building the leading AI\-native platform for family\-led care. America is facing a growing care crisis. Millions more people need care at home than ever. Over 50 million family caregivers support loved ones without the tools, training, or recognition they deserve. We believe families are the largest untapped caregiving workforce in America, and that technology can help them deliver better care while driving stronger outcomes and greater transparency across the healthcare system. Abby Care combines clinical oversight with an AI\-powered platform to train, enable, and support family caregivers in delivering high\-quality care at home. Our platform helps health plans and government partners better understand, verify, and improve care in the home. We expand access to care, reduce reliance on higher\-cost settings, and help ensure public dollars are spent effectively. We are proud to partner with leading health plans, providers, and community organizations and are backed by top VCs. We envision a future where family\-led care is a core part of the healthcare system. Abby Care is building that future. **Join us in solving one of the most important challenges of our time.** **The Opportunity** ------------------- Abby Care is building an AI\-native operating system for home care—one that manages the full lifecycle from caregiver and patient intake through care delivery, billing, and compliance. As we expand our capacity to support more family caregivers at scale, we’re looking for a Senior Applied AI Engineer to design and build production AI systems that automate complex, consequential healthcare workflows. Reporting to the Applied AI Leader, you will own major initiatives from initial problem definition through production deployment and measurable impact. Depending on the problem, you may build an agent that collects clinical documentation, interprets evidence across multiple records, prepares a prior authorization packet, assists a nurse during a visit, identifies billing risk, or coordinates operational follow\-up. You will determine how workflows should be decomposed, what context and tools an AI system needs, how its behavior should be evaluated, where deterministic controls are required, and when a human must intervene. You will work closely with product engineers, product managers, designers, clinicians, operators, and analysts to ensure that the systems you build reflect real\-world workflows and produce meaningful outcomes. High\-agency and pragmatic, you are comfortable operating in ambiguity, moving between experimentation and production engineering, and owning technically complex systems end to end. If you are excited to apply frontier AI capabilities to difficult, high\-impact problems while transforming care in the home, we’d love to hear from you! This is a full\-time hybrid opportunity based in San Francisco, California, with four days per week in person. **What you’ll work on** ----------------------- * **Own high\-impact AI systems end to end:** Lead initiatives from workflow discovery and technical design through production deployment, iteration, and measurable business or care outcomes. * **Build reliable agents and copilots:** Develop systems that reason over structured and unstructured data, use internal tools, and execute multi\-step workflows across intake, care delivery, billing, and operations. * **Engineer for real\-world complexity:** Design systems that handle incomplete information, conflicting evidence, changing requirements, and operational edge cases by combining models, retrieval, rules, state machines, and human oversight. * **Build rigorous evaluation and monitoring:** Create representative datasets, evaluation harnesses, production tracing, confidence\-based escalation, and systematic error\-analysis processes. * **Integrate AI into complete workflows:** Partner with Product, Design, Clinical, Operations, Analytics, Platform, and System of Record engineers to ensure AI capabilities solve real problems rather than remain isolated prototypes. * **Raise the technical bar:** Contribute reusable platform capabilities, shape architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and improve how the team builds and operates Applied AI systems. **What success looks like** --------------------------- * You independently own and deliver complex Applied AI systems from discovery through sustained production operation. * The systems you build create measurable improvements in workflow completion, speed, quality, operational capacity, or family experience. * AI behavior is supported by representative evaluations, systematic error analysis, and clear production monitoring. * Your systems respond safely to uncertainty through confidence handling, escalation, and human approval where appropriate. * AI capabilities are integrated into end\-t or Applied AI experience. * Experience building and operating AI\- or machine\-learning\-powered systems in production. * Strong hands\-on experience with language models, retrieval systems, structured generation, model APIs, or agent architectures. * Strong software engineering fundamentals, including backend systems, APIs, data modeling, testing, and observability. * Experience designing evaluations and analyzing the behavior of probabilistic systems. * Demonstrated ability to take ownership of ambiguous, cross\-functional problems and drive them through implementation and iteration. * Strong judgment about where AI is appropriate and where deterministic approaches or human review are required. * Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to technical and nontechnical partners. * Experience mentoring engineers, leading technically complex projects, or influencing architectural decisions. * Must reside in or be willing to permanently relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area. * Experience with model fine\-tuning, post\-training, reinforcement learning, synthetic data generation, multimodal models, document intelligence, knowledge graphs, ontologies, workflow engines, or state machines is preferred but not required. * Experience in healthcare, fintech, insurance, or another regulated and operations\-intensive environment is preferred but not required. **Benefits** * **Competitive compensation packages** that reflect the value you bring. We reward our team for the impact of their work. * **Comprehensive health coverage that works for you.** Choose from high\-quality medical dental and vision options, including a $0 deductible PPO and a company\-funded HSA, alongside employer\-paid life and disability insurance. * **Generous paid time off.** We provide policies that allow you to recharge along with 10 paid company holidays. * **Financial savings benefits to support your future.** We support your financial well\-being with HSA contributions, optional FSA and commuter benefits, and full coverage of all 401(k) account fees (employer match not currently offered). * **Paid parental leave to support your growing family.** We provide paid leave, so you can focus on bonding and adjusting to life as your family grows. **Our Values** -------------- * **Families First** Redefining healthcare starts with how we treat the parents and children we serve. We go above and beyond for every family, building strong, lasting relationships. We continually ask ourselves, *“Would we want this for our own families?”* * **Urgency with Precision** Millions of families are waiting for care, and they cannot wait, therefore this is not your typical 9 to 5 job. We match their urgency with our own, delivering exceptional care without compromise. Here, speed and excellence go hand in hand**.** * **Relentlessly Resourceful** As an ambitious startup, we adapt quickly and make the most of limited time and resources. We solve challenges with creativity to deliver results without unnecessary complexity. * **Purpose with Positivity** We take our mission seriously while never losing sight of the people behind the work. Respect, kindness, memes, and coffee make us stronger as a team and better for the families we serve. * **Driven to Redefine What’s Possible** We are here to make healthcare better, which means asking hard questions, challenging outdated systems, and finding smarter, more compassionate ways to deliver care. ***Automated Decision Tools*** *Abby Care may use automated decision tools to help match and rank candidate work experience, education and skills found in online profiles, resumes and job applications against job requirements. We believe that these tools help ensure objective, data\-based decisions during the hiring process, however, all Abby Care hiring decisions involve final human review and input. If you have questions or would like to request an alternative process, contact* *talent@abbycare.org**.* Compensation Range: $220K \- $270K

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: **Position Summary** Adeptus Solutions, Inc. is seeking a motivated and experienced**Full Stack Developer**to join our software development team. The ideal candidate will design, develop, integrate, test, and maintain high\-quality software solutions across both front\-end and back\-end technologies. The Full Stack Developer will work closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, QA Engineers, and other developers to translate user stories, business requirements, business rules, and acceptance criteria into scalable, secure, and maintainable software solutions. This position will work within an**Agile/SAFe environment**and participate throughout the software development lifecycle, including requirements refinement, development, testing, code review, deployment, and production support. The successful candidate will be capable of working independently on complex development tasks, contributing to technical and architectural discussions, troubleshooting application issues, and providing technical guidance and mentorship to less experienced developers. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, test, integrate, and maintain full\-stack software applications. * Translate user stories, acceptance criteria, business requirements, and business rules into technical solutions. * Develop responsive, accessible, and user\-friendly front\-end applications using modern web technologies. * Develop back\-end services, APIs, application logic, and system integrations. * Design, develop, and maintain database solutions using relational and/or NoSQL technologies. * Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize existing code to improve application performance, reliability, and maintainability. * Write clean, efficient, secure, reusable, and well\-documented code. * Participate in software architecture and technical design discussions. * Estimate development effort and identify technical dependencies, risks, and constraints. * Participate in peer code reviews and promote software development best practices. * Develop and maintain unit, integration, and automated tests. * Collaborate with Business Analysts and Product Managers to clarify requirements, workflows, business rules, and acceptance criteria. * Collaborate with QA Engineers to troubleshoot, reproduce, and resolve software defects. * Participate in Agile/SAFe ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and PI Planning. * Use Azure DevOps (ADO) or similar development and work\-management platforms to manage assigned user stories, tasks, defects, and development activities. * Support CI/CD pipelines and software deployment activities. * Troubleshoot and resolve application issues across development, test, staging, and production environments. * Participate in root\-cause analysis and implement corrective actions for application defects and production issues. * Contribute to technical documentation, system documentation, and knowledge\-sharing activities. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior developers as appropriate. * Stay current with emerging technologies and recommend improvements that provide value to the organization. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Required Skills \& Qualifications** * Minimum of 10 years of professional software development experience. * Strong experience developing both front\-end and back\-end applications. * Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages such as TypeScript/JavaScript, C\#, Java, Python, or similar. * Experience with modern front\-end development frameworks; Angular is strongly preferred. * Experience with back\-end frameworks and technologies such as .NET, Node.js, Java/Spring, Python/Django, or similar. * Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and system integrations. * Strong understanding of relational and/or NoSQL databases. * Experience with Git and modern source\-control practices. * Experience throughout the software development lifecycle. * Experience working in an Agile software development environment. * Strong problem\-solving, debugging, and analytical skills. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a cross\-functional team environment. * Strong verbal and written communication skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Professional experience developing applications using Angular and TypeScript. * Experience with Angular components, services, routing, state management, and API integration. * Experience working within a SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) environment. * Experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) or similar development and work\-management platforms. * Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps/DevSecOps practices. * Experience with automated testing frameworks and practices. * Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other containerization technologies. * Experience with application monitoring, logging, and performance optimization. * Experience implementing secure coding practices. * Experience developing accessible applications in accordance with applicable accessibility standards. * Prior experience mentoring junior or mid\-level developers. * Relevant technical certifications. **Education** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience. **Core Competencies** * Full\-stack software development * Angular and TypeScript development * Front\-end and back\-end development * API and system integration * Database development * Software architecture and design * Agile/SAFe development practices * Azure DevOps and work\-item management * CI/CD and DevOps practices * Automated testing * Debugging and troubleshooting * Root\-cause analysis * Secure and maintainable software development * Technical documentation * Analytical thinking and attention to detail * Effective communication and collaboration * Adaptability and continuous learning * Technical leadership and mentorship

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Adobe is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join the Adobe Risk Platform (ARP) team. ARP is Adobe's centralized, adaptive system for detecting, preventing, and mitigating fraud and abuse across products and services — protecting surfaces like Commerce, Stock, and Firefly with real\-time risk decisions, without degrading the customer experience. In this position, you will help build and develop machine learning models to identify fraudulent activity, detect abusive account behavior, and protect the experience of hundreds of millions of users. You'll work across the model lifecycle from raw behavioral data and feature engineering, to model training, deployment, and monitoring alongside senior engineers on the team. Key Responsibilities Help build and train ML models covering various fraud and abuse areas. These include financial transaction fraud, device\-related deception, and account and identity abuse. The goal is a unified, continuously\-updated trust and risk score. Contribute to feature engineering across transaction, device, and behavioral event data. Build and maintain feature pipelines on Databricks and Spark, transforming raw transaction and device event data into high\-quality model inputs. Help translate prototypes into production ML systems, working with senior engineers on scalability, reliability, and observability. **Support MLOps practices:** experiment tracking, model versioning, CI/CD, and production monitoring. Collaborate cross\-functionally with data science, product, and platform teams to understand fraud and abuse patterns across Adobe's surfaces. Stay ahead of advances in ML/AI, particularly in fraud detection and behavioral modeling, and bring relevant ideas to the team. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or related field (or equivalent experience). 5\+ years of professional experience building and deploying ML solutions, or equivalent experience through internships, research, or personal projects. Solid programming skills in Python, with hands\-on experience in PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit\-learn, or similar frameworks. Working understanding of the ML lifecycle — from data collection through deployment and monitoring. Eagerness to learn model optimization, inference efficiency, and production system integration, with support from senior engineers on the team. Preferred Qualifications **Coursework, projects, or professional experience in any of:** payment fraud, device fingerprinting, account takeover detection, anomaly detection, or graph\-based modeling. Exposure to sequence modeling, transformer architectures, or graph neural networks. Familiarity with Databricks, Spark, or large\-scale transactional/event pipelines. jobs.title: Sr / Staff Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Join Adobe Security Engineering and help build the ML and generative AI capabilities that protect Adobe, our products, and our customers. Our team sits where cybersecurity, large\-scale data, and AI meet, building models for anomaly detection, threat detection, investigation, and security analytics across some of Adobe's largest datasets. As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you'll design, build, and scale production ML systems spanning deep learning, behavioral modeling, embeddings, and agentic AI. You'll write code, train models, run experiments, and help shape the architecture the broader team builds on. You'll also partner closely with data, platform, and security engineers across Adobe. The Challenge Architect end\-to\-end ML systems for high\-volume security data, turning experiments into reusable capabilities. Own the ML lifecycle, from feature engineering through training, deployment, monitoring, and retraining. Build LLM and agentic AI capabilities for security investigation, including retrieval\-augmented generation. Design evaluation frameworks that measure model quality and help analysts trust and validate results. Work with data and platform engineers to scale pipelines and resolve system bottlenecks together. Mentor engineers and help guide technical direction through design reviews and hands\-on collaboration. What you bring Experience running production ML systems from early experimentation through sustained operation at scale. A strong background training models with PyTorch and transformers, including behavioral modeling and anomaly detection. Comfort with distributed compute like Spark, cloud platforms like AWS, and MLOps tools like MLflow. Experience building with LLMs or generative AI, along with evaluating how they behave in production. Strong Python and SQL skills, and solid software engineering habits like testing and code review. A collaborative approach to mentoring engineers and shaping technical direction across teams. MS or PhD in computer science, machine learning, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Nice to have Background applying ML to cybersecurity, fraud, or similar adversarial problems. Experience with vector databases, RAG, or multi\-agent systems. Publications, patents, or open\-source contributions to ML or AI. jobs.title: Threat Intelligence / Reverse Engineering Investigator
jobs.description: The Threat Intelligence / Reverse Engineering Investigator identifies, investigates, and disrupts fraud, abuse, and adversarial activity targeting Adobe's products, services, and ecosystem. Through threat intelligence, reverse engineering, technical investigations, detection engineering, and AI\-driven capabilities, the team delivers actionable intelligence and scalable mitigations that strengthen platform resilience and protect Adobe, its customers, and its ecosystem. Key Responsibilities \& Areas of Impact \- The responsibilities below represent the primary areas of focus for this role and may evolve alongside emerging risks, business priorities, and organizational needs. Threat Intelligence \& Adversary Research Monitor and assess adversarial activity, fraud, abuse, and emerging threats impacting Adobe products, services, and business operations. Assess threat actors, campaigns, and evolving adversarial behaviors to understand risk exposure and support proactive threat mitigation efforts. Leverage open\- and closed\-source intelligence, industry partnerships, intelligence\-sharing communities, and emerging data sources to enhance threat visibility and intelligence collection capabilities. Produce intelligence assessments and threat reporting that inform detection, investigations, and operational decision\-making. Reverse Engineering, Investigations \& Detection Reverse engineer and analyze malicious tooling, automation frameworks, browser extensions, attack infrastructure, and other mechanisms used to target or abuse Adobe services, documenting attacker methodologies and identifying opportunities for disruption. Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI\-enabled attack techniques, adversarial tooling, and automation frameworks, to identify evolving threats and develop scalable detection and mitigation strategies. Conduct complex technical investigations into fraud, abuse, account compromise, platform misuse, and other malicious activity, including escalation analysis, attribution, root cause determination, and identification of coordinated threat activity. Discover exploited or potential vulnerabilities and partner with stakeholders to develop mitigation strategies, remediation plans, and long\-term risk reduction approaches. Translate intelligence and investigative findings into scalable detection, monitoring, prevention, and enforcement capabilities. Develop and maintain investigative methodologies, detection workflows, and operational processes that support effective threat detection, analysis, and response. Strategic Collaboration \& Influence Partner with Product, Security, Engineering, Data Science, Risk, Trust \& Safety, and other stakeholders to mitigate threats, improve platform resilience, and strengthen customer protection. Support incident response and emerging threat investigations by providing intelligence, attribution analysis, investigative expertise, and strategic guidance. Develop executive\-ready briefings, investigative summaries, and risk assessments that communicate findings, business impact, and strategic recommendations. Advise stakeholders on intelligence\-driven risk mitigation, fraud prevention, abuse prevention, and vulnerability management strategies. Serve as a subject matter expert on adversarial behavior, emerging threats, and fraud trends, helping inform long\-term threat reduction and platform protection strategies. **Qualifications \& Core Competencies :** Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex investigative, intelligence, and technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for technical, operational, and executive audiences. Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify patterns, assess risk, and transform complex data and intelligence into meaningful insights that drive informed decision\-making. Creative and strategic problem\-solving capabilities, including the ability to anticipate emerging threats, identify gaps, and develop innovative, scalable solutions to mitigate risk. A naturally inquisitive and investigative mindset, with a passion for understanding adversarial behavior, attacker methodologies, emerging technologies, and evolving fraud and abuse trends. Experience using SQL /SPL and data analysis techniques to support investigations, identify patterns, uncover actionable intelligence, and validate investigative hypotheses. Proven ability to manage competing priorities and adapt quickly in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment while maintaining high\-quality outcomes. Self\-motivated, proactive, and comfortable operating with ambiguity, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively across cross\-functional teams. Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and a commitment to quality, ensuring thorough, accurate, and high\-confidence investigative outcomes. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Loan Origination and Reporting)
jobs.description: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. The Engineering team builds systems that power Affirm's mission. We take pride in our craft, building reliable, performant, and scalable solutions that touch every part of the business. Whether we're enabling new ways to pay, ensuring our platforms can scale to the most demanding levels in the industry, or developing seamless servicing experiences, our focus is on solving complex problems through exceptional engineering. ### **About the role** As a Senior Software Engineer on Loan Origination and Reporting, you'll build and scale the data platforms and services that process loan originations in real time and deliver accurate reporting to Affirm and its financial partners, strengthening the core financial engine behind transparent, reliable ways to pay over time. ### **What you'll do** * You will be responsible for owning and delivering quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers on your team through ambiguity to solve open\-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery. * You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design \& analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade\-offs. * You will proactively identify project, process, technology or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them. * You will support the operations and availability of your team's artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting "keep the lights on" \& on\-call efforts. * You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting or improving code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks. * You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example. ### **What we look for** * You have 4\+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin. * You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes. * You have deep expertise in designing and operating scalable backend data pipelines and batch processing systems using Spark, Airflow, or similar distributed frameworks. * You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others. * You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely. * + Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders. * You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team. * This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor's degree in a related field. Base Pay Grade\- N Equity Grade\- 9 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job\-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.) USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $195,000 \- $255,000 USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $173,000 \- $233,000 \#LI\-Remote **Remote\-first with flexibility built in** Affirm is proud to be a remote\-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. semi\-structured, and unstructured data from multiple sources. * Develop scalable, reproducible, and idempotent ETL/ELT pipelines for large and complex datasets. * Implement data transformation, normalization, validation, cleansing, and quarantine processes. * Maintain comprehensive record\-level data lineage from source systems through downstream datasets. * Capture and manage metadata for DynamoDB and document\-oriented data. * Support AWS\-based data ingestion, processing, storage, and analytics workflows. * Process scanned permits, certificates, applications, and other document\-based records. * Implement OCR and document\-intelligence solutions to extract structured information from scanned documents. * Track extracted values back to the originating document, page, and relevant region or location. * Implement field\-level confidence scores and validation mechanisms for extracted information. * Develop workflows to route low\-confidence or potentially inaccurate extractions for human review. * Implement processes for identifying, masking, protecting, and appropriately controlling access to PII and sensitive information. * Develop data\-quality checks, validation rules, exception handling, and quarantine mechanisms. * Identify and resolve data inconsistencies, missing values, duplicates, formatting issues, and other legacy\-data quality problems. * Develop data\-quality scorecards and metrics to monitor completeness, accuracy, consistency, and reliability. * Ensure pipelines and data\-processing workflows are secure, auditable, maintainable, and well documented. * Develop technical documentation covering pipeline architecture, data mappings, transformations, lineage, validation rules, and operational procedures. * Collaborate with data scientists, data analysts, engineers, security teams, and business stakeholders to support data modernization initiatives. * Support the development of trusted, standardized, and AI\-ready datasets for downstream analytics and machine\-learning applications. Required Qualifications * 7–10\+ years of experience in data engineering, data science, data analytics, or a related field. * Advanced programming experience with Python and SQL. * Hands\-on experience designing and implementing AWS\-based data platforms and processing solutions. * Strong experience with PostgreSQL and relational database design. * Hands\-on experience with DynamoDB and document\-oriented data models. * Strong understanding of ETL/ELT pipelines and modern data\-engineering practices. * Experience with Bronze/Silver/Gold medallion architectures, lakehouse concepts, or similar layered data architectures. * Experience implementing data lineage, metadata management, and data traceability solutions. * Experience processing structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured/document\-based data. * Hands\-on experience with OCR, document processing, document intelligence, or structured information extraction. * Experience working with large\-scale legacy\-data cleansing, transformation, and modernization efforts. * Experience implementing data\-quality, validation, normalization, and exception\-handling processes. * Understanding of PII protection, security controls, data governance, and access management. * Ability to develop reproducible, maintainable, and well\-documented data pipelines and analytical code. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and problem\-solving skills. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS runs the world's largest fleet of AI/ML accelerator servers. jobs.title: Sr. Software Development Engineer – AI/ML Networking Disaggregated Inference, Annapurna Labs, Annapurna Labs
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Every token a large language model generates depends on data reaching the right accelerator at the right moment. As AI models outgrow any single chip, the network between accelerators becomes the bottleneck that decides how fast — and how affordably — the world's largest models can serve real users. That network layer is what our team builds. We're looking for an engineer to work at the frontier of disaggregated inference: splitting LLM serving into separate prefill and decode pools and moving the model's KV cache between them at the absolute limit of what the hardware allows. Get it right and users get answers in milliseconds; get it wrong and the fastest accelerators in the world sit idle waiting on data. You'll own pieces of the high\-speed transfer path that make the difference, and you'll measure your success in how close you run to the theoretical peak of the machine. In this role you will: Build and optimize the low\-level data\-movement software across accelerators, servers, and heterogeneous memory — over AWS's highest\-performance network fabric. Push performance to the hardware roofline: profile, find the real bottleneck, and close the gap between "it works" and "it runs as fast as physics permits." Work across the stack — from kernel and network transport up to the inference frameworks — and partner with teams building the chips, runtime, and models. Deliver features that run on our largest clusters, for our largest customers, serving the largest AI models in production. What we're looking for: Strong C/C\+\+ and a love for low\-level, performance\-critical systems — solid command of Linux, kernels, memory, and writing fast code. The instinct to ask "how fast could this possibly go?" and the rigor to measure it. Experience with high\-speed networking or HPC interconnects (RDMA, InfiniBand, libfabric, UCX, NIXL, MPI) is valued highly; embedded\-systems experience is a plus. Prior AI/ML experience is welcome but not required — if you're a great systems engineer, we'll teach you the ML side. If you like solving genuinely hard problems, working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with HPC and ML customers, iterating fast, and shipping at a scale few places can offer, come join us. This is a role on the leading edge of AI/ML infrastructure. About the team: You'd be joining Annapurna Labs, an integral part of AWS. Annapurna designs the hardware and software building blocks behind EC2 — every EC2 instance runs on hardware we designed. We specialize in the chips, systems, and software that optimize the AWS customer experience, and this team sits where cutting\-edge AI meets the silicon and the network underneath it. A day in the life Annapurna Labs, a crucial part of AWS, is responsible for developing hardware and software components for EC2 infrastructure. Our team focuses on building networking solutions that for Machine Learning (ML) and High\-Performance Computing (HPC) workloads on AWS. We have mixed discipline orgs, you’d be working side by side with infrastructure experts, hardware engineers, RTL engineers, scientists \& architects. Our workforce spans the globe and is truly international, you’ll find yourself working side by side with individuals from numerous countries. With support from the National Science Foundation (NSF) through the American University Translating Research into Action Center (TRAC), the dashboard will scale to include data and analyses for all nine\-core human rights treaties and implementation/monitoring communities. This position integrates data science, software engineering, and applied research, contributing to the analytical methods that generate insight from UN treaty body documents and the technical systems that deliver those insights to users. Responsibilities include developing and refining NLP and text analysis pipelines, designing and computing indicators and metrics from structured and unstructured data, building and maintaining the Streamlit\-based dashboard and its supporting codebase, collaborating on AI\-assisted research features, managing deployment and infrastructure on Posit Connect Cloud, contributing to the platform's evolution toward a comprehensive Advocacy Toolkit, and supporting user testing, documentation, and research dissemination activities. The position reports to the Principal Investigator, Dr. Derrick Cogburn, and works at the intersection of disability rights research, data science, and software development. The position will be based in the American University Institute on Disability and Public Policy (https://www.idppglobal.org). IDPP is a multidisciplinary, cross\-campus research center that creates and disseminates knowledge that enables all persons to participate effectively in society, locally, nationally, and globally. IDPP uses supervised and unsupervised machine learning, deep learning, text analysis, natural language processing (NLP), and large language models (LLMs) to evaluate progress on disability rights globally and specifically on implementing the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (CRPD) and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). IDPP also explores the role of accessible information and communication technologies (ICTs) and digital technologies, including telepresence robots and mobile apps, to accelerate full participation in society for persons with disabilities. IDPP was the lead organization for the AU 2030 Strategic Initiative on Global Disability and Development and worked in conjunction with several other campus organizations to lead the Strategic Research Initiative on Inclusive Technology and Policy (ITP). IDPP was founded in 2009 through the generous support of The Nippon Foundation and was initially focused on Southeast Asia. IDPP works in partnership with the World Bank’s Disability Data Hub (https://disabilitydata.worldbank.org/en/home) and the Disability Data Initiative (https://www.disabilitydatainitiative.org/) led by Fordham University. Both initiatives providing quantitative disability data for the Disability Rights Dashboard. **Essential Functions:** 1\.)
